meta.name: stakeholder-identification
meta.description: Map every stakeholder before engaging anyone. Use when launching an initiative, scoping discovery, or building an engagement plan from scratch.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 梳理项目所有相关方，制定参与计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要系统识别和管理项目中的关键干系人
copy.tagline_en: Map all stakeholders and plan their engagement
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to identify and manage key stakeholders in your project

howto.what: 当你说出一个项目或决策时，Claude 会引导你系统性地列出所有相关方，包括容易被忽略的群体，并分类标记为盟友、受众、影响者，以及资源、许可、决策角色，最后选出2-3个最需要优先理解的关键相关方。
howto.when: 当你启动一个新项目、规划调研或编写PRD的相关方部分时，可以要求Claude进行相关方识别。

say.text: 帮我识别迁移所有客户到新计费系统的相关方。
say.note: Claude会引导你完成完整的识别流程。

say.text: 我们现有的相关方列表可能漏了谁？
say.note: Claude会应用公平性视角检查盲点。

say.text: 为我的PRD准备相关方部分。
say.note: Claude会输出分类和标记后的列表。

howto.what_en: When you name an initiative or decision, Claude guides you to systematically list all stakeholders, including often-overlooked groups, categorize them as Allies/Audiences/Influencers, mark R/P/D tags, and narrow to 2-3 priority stakeholders to understand first.
howto.when_en: When launching a new initiative, scoping discovery, or preparing a PRD stakeholder section, ask Claude to identify stakeholders.

say_en.text: Identify stakeholders for migrating all customers to the new billing system.
say_en.note: Claude will walk through the full identification process.

say_en.text: Are we missing anyone important in our stakeholder map?
say_en.note: Claude applies an equity lens to check blind spots.

say_en.text: Help me prepare the stakeholder section of my PRD.
say_en.note: Claude outputs a categorized and tagged list.
